text:
mike: heads-up — running into weird module resolution in the repo when running the edge sample with `vercel dev`. error: "Could not resolve '@redwood/inference-sdk'". Works after `pnpm -w build` but that defeats quick dev flow.

nina: pnpm workspaces + symlinks + package `exports` are the usual suspects. Can you paste package.json from the sdk package?

mike: yes — sdk pkg has `type: module`, `exports` pointing at ./dist/index.mjs, types to ./dist/index.d.ts, and main/module fields. No dev alias.

kevin: Vercel's dev uses esbuild which reads the package.json at the symlink entrypoint. Because pnpm keeps packages symlinked, relative exports can resolve to the wrong path. Also some dev servers don't preserve `--preserve-symlinks`.

tara: quick repro: fresh container, `pnpm -w install`, cd example/sample-app, `vercel dev` -> fails. If you `pnpm -w build` in root it works. Editor/TS sometimes also resolve to root package.json which hides exports.

mike: workaround that helped me: add a Vite alias in sample-app vite.config: `alias: {'@redwood/inference-sdk': path.resolve(__dirname, '../../packages/sdk/src')}`. Unpleasant for onboarding.

nina: alternatives: 1) add a small `dev.mjs` at package root that re-exports from src and add `module` or `browser` field pointing to it for local dev; 2) add a `pnpm dev:link` script that creates a shallow package in node_modules pointing to src; 3) update tsconfig `paths` so editors resolve types to src.

kevin: note: editing node_modules in CI is frowned upon but acceptable as a dev convenience if gated and documented. Another option: have a repo-level script that rewrites package.json exports to include `./dev` mapping before running dev servers, and restore afterwards.

tara: action items: 1) document the hoisting/symlink gotcha in dev onboarding; 2) add a `dev-link` helper script to the repo for developers; 3) add a fast CI smoke `pnpm --filter sample-app test:dev-resolve` that runs a headless dev resolver to catch regressions.

ci-bot: CI note: include `pnpm --filter sample-app test:dev-resolve` in the quick matrix. Also flag any scripts that mutate node_modules with a `--danger` flag in docs.

mike: i'll open a small PR with the dev-link script + docs and include tsconfig paths snippet. Will coordinate with runtime team about preserveSymlinks behavior. Thanks all.

kevin: small follow-up: if we add a dev.mjs, ensure sourcemaps/types still work for TS so breakpoints aren't confusing.

mike: noted — will include a tiny tsconfig patch in the PR.
